description: This file defines the 'Minus' class, which implements a binary subtraction operation as part of a calculator project. It extends 'AbstractOperation' and implements 'BinaryOperation', providing the perform method for subtraction and a getName method returning '-'.

classes.name: Minus
classes.description: Represents a binary subtraction operation in the calculator, extending AbstractOperation and implementing BinaryOperation.

methods.name: perform
methods.description: Performs subtraction of two float arguments.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the symbol representing the operation, which is '-' in this case.
